description: This file defines classes and constants related to front panel indicators, including color management, blinking sequences, and brightness control, within a device settings namespace. It includes class declarations for FrontPanelIndicator, its nested classes Color and Blink, and related methods and properties.

classes.name: FrontPanelIndicator
classes.description: Manages front panel indicator properties such as color, blink sequence, brightness, and state.

classes.name: FrontPanelIndicator::Color
classes.description: Represents predefined colors for the front panel indicator, extending DSConstant.

classes.name: FrontPanelIndicator::Blink
classes.description: Handles blink sequence parameters including interval and iteration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instances of FrontPanelIndicator or Color based on id or name.

methods.name: getBrightness
methods.description: Returns the current brightness level of the indicator.

methods.name: getBrightnessLevels
methods.description: Retrieves brightness levels, minimum, and maximum values.

methods.name: getColorMode
methods.description: Returns the color mode (single or multi-color).

methods.name: getBlink
methods.description: Returns the Blink object with current blink sequence parameters.

methods.name: getMaxCycleRate
methods.description: Returns the maximum cycle rate for LED scrolling.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the current color ID of the indicator.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level of the indicator.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the indicator using a Color object or RGB value.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns whether the indicator is enabled.

methods.name: getSupportedColors
methods.description: Returns a list of supported colors.
